text: The Regional Drought Resilience Planning Program (Tasmania) is a state-level initiative under the national Future Drought Fund framework, aimed at enhancing drought resilience across Tasmania. It involves creating tailored drought resilience plans for the North, North-West, and South regions of Tasmania, focusing on preparedness, adaptation, and management of future droughts. The program emphasizes community engagement, evidence-based planning, and integration with existing climate adaptation initiatives.
